# Peoria Water Filtration

## About
Peoria Water Filtration provides licensed water filtration and softening system installation for homes and businesses throughout Peoria, IL and surrounding communities. All work is performed by a licensed master plumber. We start with a free in-home water quality test before recommending any system, so you know exactly what is in your water before spending anything.

## Services
- Free In-Home Water Quality Testing (lead, PFAS, hardness, contaminants)
- Whole-House Water Filtration Systems
- Under-Sink Water Filtration (reverse osmosis and carbon filter systems)
- Water Softeners (for Peoria's documented hard water — 22.4 GPG)
- Combination Filtration and Softening Systems
- Well Water Filtration and Treatment
- Water Heater Protection Systems (scale prevention for hard water areas)
- Filter Maintenance and Replacement

## Service Area
Peoria, East Peoria, Pekin, Dunlap, Chillicothe, Washington, Morton, Bartonville, Peoria County, Tazewell County

## Contact
Phone: 309-322-7015
Website: https://peoriawaterfiltration.com

## Why Choose Us
Peoria's water carries documented issues — a 2025 lead warning from Illinois American Water, PFAS contaminants exceeding EPA health guidelines, and hardness at 22.4 grains per gallon. We are a locally owned operation staffed by a licensed master plumber, not a sales tech. The water test is genuinely free with no obligation, and we will tell you if your water does not need treatment.
